comment: Month-end outstanding of every live trade-finance instrument from Apr-2024 (the complete trade history) to Sep-2026, replayed from the instrument lifecycle events (issue / amend / present / accept / pay / expire / claim): outstanding USD and LCY with the instrument's product, corridor, commodity, beneficiary and counterparty-bank country, booking location, maturity / expiry fiscal quarter and days to maturity. POINT-IN-TIME: never sum outstanding across month-ends - pick one month_end_date (is_latest_month_end = 30-Sep-2026, or quarter-ends for trends) or use the semi-additive last value. Answers guarantees / SBLCs outstanding by beneficiary country and expiry quarter and trade exposure to carbon-intensive commodities. Grain: one row per trade-finance instrument per month-end while its outstanding is above zero.
